title: A Day for Myself
content:
Sophie had a busy week. She worked every day and felt very tired.

On Saturday morning, she decided to practice self-care.

— I need a quiet day — she said.

She took a warm shower and made a healthy breakfast.

— I feel better already!

Then, Sophie went to the park.

— I love walking here. It is so peaceful.

Her friend Emma called her.

— Are you busy?

— No, I am relaxing today.

— That sounds nice!

— Yes. I think everyone needs some self-care.

In the afternoon, Sophie read a book and listened to music.

— I don't need to do everything today — she said.

At the end of the day, she smiled.

— I am happy because I took care of myself.
